scope: Complete checker/adapters and listed integration guidance; contextual read of implementation plus source-bound existing tests, not whole-repository acceptance
reviewer: same implementation agent; not independent blinded reviewer

rules.review: Native tools receive argv arrays, stdin JSON and no shell=True/eval; PowerShell invokes parser/analyzer against literal path arguments.
No generated embedded source from input. Markdown fence recognition routes contextual surfaces only.
Not applicable: no database/SQL sink in reviewed checker/adapters/config.
JSON serialization owns stdin/report transport; duplicate config keys rejected by existing verification.unique_object.
Repository CI uses fixed commands, runner-temp only in quoted shell variables; no issue/PR content inserted into source.
Not applicable: no HTML output in checker/adapters.
Fence regex is fixed; source lines are matched data, not regex source.
Not applicable: no URL construction/network requests in checker/adapters.
Git uses NUL delimiters; tracked symlinks never followed; normal entries checked for containment; ShellCheck/Ruff receive -- before paths; TypeScript/PowerShell use absolute path lists through JSON.
No credentials in config. Native findings use path/location/rule diagnostics; generic TS/PS failures omit raw source. No secret-bearing environment dump.
Tools.json owns pinned native versions/rule selection; adapter gates pin their API/runtime dependencies. Existing MCP package scripts remain authoritative for build/typecheck.
Per-scan state local; tool API lifetime owned by adapter; immutable source identity captured before scan and rechecked after.
Existing verification catalog/runner and NUL-safe verification-impact selector reused; language adapters retain distinct native output semantics.
Native parsers own syntax. Census classification is routing, not exemption or semantic approval. Exception needs exact path/content and existing resolver control.
Census/selection/native adaptation and product check discovery remain separate; no universal parser or product state engine.
Only all/diff and explicit supported language scope added; no project-wide preset auto-installation or additional public gate.
Missing files/tools/history/config and malformed outputs propagate failure; no baseline suppressions or success fallback.
Main maps operational errors to status:error/finding_count:null/exit2. TS/PS catch returns fixed failure, not empty success. Invalid native JSON cannot be parsed as no findings.
Nonzero tools without findings reject; Bash syntax additionally checked despite filtered ShellCheck subset; catalog wrapper returns actual main status.

Config shape/version and bounded exception fields validated before native invocation. Native output is trusted version-pinned tool protocol, not a project plugin output. Malformed output raises errors.
TS parses AST and reports AnyKeyword; not an unsafe narrowing implementation. unknown, named properties and string any are normal controls.
No detached async tasks in checker. TS synchronous API closes in finally; catalog owns scheduling.
Git timeout60/native timeout120; temporary fixture directories cleanup; TS API.close on normal/caught error. Descendant termination on forced parent timeout has not been independently demonstrated.
Not applicable: checker has no automatic retries.
Exact version/schema/rule tokens; .suffix normalization only for language routing, not protocol authorization.
Native subprocess transport is explicit strict UTF-8. Git paths decoded UTF-8, source identity hashes raw bytes; classification replacement decoding never certifies syntax.
Tests use temporary repositories/path variants; no fixture-specific production pass branch. Single invalid-source exception bound to exact hash/control, not filename alone.
Native tools supply independent syntax/rule diagnostics; nine post-freeze heldout cases supplement development fixtures. Mock failures test transport only, not native behavior.
Reports distinguish inspected/selected/population, native findings and manual unknown, no-targets and unavailable. Local evidence does not assert remote CI/native host invocation.
No product required-set contract changed. Native subset0 is not all-rule compliance. Historical/human-copy and embedded routing remain visible to contextual review.

unverified: actual model adherence to conditional project guidance
remote CI and host execution owned by root integration
